short.en: Respond to every call that excites your spirit.
The line is bad; can you hear me clearly on your end?
short.zh: 信号不好，你那边能听清我说话吗？
short.note: line 电话线路；on your end 你那边。

short.en: That which does not kill us makes us stronger.
short.zh: 凡不能毁灭我的，必使我更强大。
short.note: stronger 比较级 /ŋ/ 后接 /g/；which 咬舌 /wɪtʃ/。

short.en: No matter what is the environment around you, it is always possible to maintain your brand of integrity.
I've had a slight headache since this morning, and my throat feels sore.
short.zh: 从早上起我有点头疼，嗓子也疼。
short.note: slight 轻微的；sore throat 嗓子疼。

short.en: Let's not overthink it and just go with it.
short.zh: 别想太多，就顺其自然吧。
short.note: overthink 重音在前；go with it 表示“随它去”。

short.en: Confirmation of Mary Peltola's victory caps of the party's rout of the Republicans in the midterms Senate election.
short.zh: 玛丽·佩尔托拉（Mary Peltola）获胜的确认标志着该党在参议院中期选举中击败共和党。

short.en: You're making a big deal out of nothing.
short.note: make a big deal out of 是固定搭配；nothing 的 /θ/ 咬舌。

short.en: Did you sleep well last night? You look a little tired today.
short.zh: 你昨晚睡得好吗？你今天看起来有点累。
short.note: sleep well 睡得好；tired 双音节。

short.en: A double suicide bombing at the Iranian embassy in Beirut kills 23 people and injures 160 others.
short.zh: 伊朗驻贝鲁特大使馆发生双重自杀式爆炸事件，造成 23 人死亡、160 人受伤。

short.en: TAP Air Portugal Flight 425 crashes in the Madeira Islands, killing 131.
short.zh: TAP 葡萄牙航空 425 号航班在马德拉群岛坠毁，造成 131 人死亡。

short.en: Could you recommend something to eat?
short.note: recommend 重音在第二音节 /ˌrekəˈmend/；something 的 /θ/ 咬舌。

short.en: I'm pretty sure I left my keys on the kitchen counter.
short.zh: 我很确定我把钥匙放厨房台面上了。
short.note: pretty sure 口语常用；counter 美音卷舌。

short.en: The current Saint Peter's Basilica is consecrated in Rome, replacing an earlier basilica on the same site.
Do not look upon this world with fear and loathing. Bravely face whatever the gods offer.
You have no idea what I've been through.
short.zh: 你根本不知道我经历了什么。
short.note: have no idea 连读；been through 表示“经历（磨难）”。

short.en: Anthropic's hotly anticipated IPO is expected to put it in the top 10 most valuable US companies, but the future is uncertain.
short.zh: Anthropic备受期待的IPO有望跻身美国最有价值公司前10名，但未来充满不确定性。

short.en: The head of Crimea said traffic was suspended after another attack on the link between Russia and the occupied territory.
short.zh: 克里米亚领导人表示，俄罗斯与被占领土之间的线路再次遭到袭击后，交通中断。

short.en: I'd like to follow up on the proposal we discussed.
short.zh: 我想跟进一下我们讨论过的方案。
short.note: follow up on 是固定搭配；proposal 重音在第二音节。

short.en: What's the daily special today, and does it come with a drink?
short.zh: 今日特色菜是什么，配饮料吗？
short.note: daily special 当日特色；come with 附带。

long.en: Learning a new language takes patience, because you will make plenty of mistakes before you feel comfortable speaking. The most useful habit is to practice a little every day, even when you are tired, rather than studying for hours once a week.
long.zh: 学一门新语言需要耐心，因为在能自如开口之前你会犯很多错。最有用的习惯是每天练一点，哪怕很累，也胜过一周突击学几小时。
long.note: plenty of 大量；rather than 而不是；comfortable 重音在第一音节。

long.en: Four score and seven years ago our fathers brought forth on this continent a new nation, conceived in liberty, and dedicated to the proposition that all men are created equal. Now we are engaged in a great civil war, testing whether that nation, or any nation so conceived and so dedicated, can long endure.
long.zh: 八十七年前，我们的先辈在这片大陆上创立了一个新国家，它孕育于自由之中，奉行人人平等的原则。如今我们正投身于一场伟大的内战，考验这个国家能否长久存在。
long.note: 长句按逗号意群停顿；conceived /kənˈsiːvd/、dedicated 重音在第一音节；civil 中 /v/ 咬唇。

long.en: A good book can carry you into another world, showing how people in different times and places think and feel. Even a short chapter each day slowly builds your vocabulary and gives you new ideas to bring into your own conversations.
long.zh: 一本好书能带你进入另一个世界，看到不同时代、不同地方的人如何思考和感受。每天哪怕只读一小节，也能慢慢积累词汇，给你的日常谈话带来新想法。
long.note: 现在分词 showing 作伴随；build vocabulary 积累词汇；chapter 双音节。

words.z: a. 理性的, 合理的
a. 苦的, 痛苦的, 怀恨的
n. 外科医生, 军医, 船医
a. 艺术的, 艺术家的, 富有艺术性的
